title: Taiwanese American Students Association
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Students Association (TASA) at Texas A&M University is a social and cultural student organization founded in 2018 and registered with the university’s Department of Student Activities. It is listed on both the university’s Get Involved portal and StuAct Online, and maintains a dedicated website at tamutasa.com. TASA is distinct from the campus TSA in that it is oriented primarily toward Taiwanese Americans and others interested in Taiwanese American culture, rather than international students from Taiwan.

The organization’s mission centers on building community among Taiwanese Americans in College Station and fostering connections with students at other universities. It pursues this through social events, cultural celebrations, volunteer activities, and educational programming. Signature events include a Cultural Showcase featuring Taiwanese traditions through food and performances. TASA describes its goal as creating an inclusive environment that connects students and enhances their understanding of Taiwanese heritage.

TASA maintains an active Instagram presence (@tasatamu) with over 1,100 followers, a Linktree hub linking to its website, Instagram, and Discord server, and a Facebook page. An older Weebly site (tasatamu.weebly.com), last updated in 2022, also exists as a legacy web presence.
